process_inventory.name: Requirements Elicitation
process_inventory.rationale: Stakeholder needs for BMS must be elicited and documented. Applies to both as_is (observed foxBMS capabilities) and synthetic_reference (hypothetical automotive project).
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic_reference stakeholder needs created; as_is back-inferred from features

process_inventory.name: System Requirements Analysis
process_inventory.rationale: System requirements derived from stakeholder needs. foxBMS has implicit system requirements in code/config; synthetic_reference needs explicit SYS requirements.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic_reference SYS requirements created; as_is reconstructed from behavior

process_inventory.name: System Architectural Design
process_inventory.rationale: System architecture allocating requirements to HW/SW. foxBMS has documented 3-layer architecture; synthetic_reference needs explicit allocation.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - HSI authority created; allocation documented

process_inventory.name: System Integration and Integration Test
process_inventory.rationale: Integration of HW/SW components. foxBMS has integration via CAN/SPI; synthetic_reference needs integration strategy and test specs.
process_inventory.disposition: partially_mapped - synthetic_reference plan created; as_is has implicit integration

process_inventory.name: System Qualification Test
process_inventory.rationale: System-level verification against requirements. foxBMS has unit tests; synthetic_reference needs system qualification test specs.
process_inventory.disposition: gap - synthetic_reference test specs created; as_is lacks system-level tests

process_inventory.name: Software Requirements Analysis
process_inventory.rationale: SW requirements from system requirements. foxBMS has implicit SW requirements in code; synthetic_reference needs explicit SW requirements.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic_reference SW requirements created per module; as_is back-inferred

process_inventory.name: Software Architectural Design
process_inventory.rationale: SW architecture with components, interfaces, data flow. foxBMS has 3-layer architecture documented; synthetic_reference needs detailed SW architecture.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - SW architecture documented per module; interfaces specified

process_inventory.name: Software Detailed Design and Unit Construction
process_inventory.rationale: Detailed design and implementation. foxBMS source code IS the detailed design; synthetic_reference maps requirements to code units.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - source code inventoried; detailed design extracted; unit tests mapped

process_inventory.name: Software Integration and Integration Test
process_inventory.rationale: SW component integration. foxBMS integrates via database/task model; synthetic_reference needs integration test specs.
process_inventory.disposition: partially_mapped - integration approach documented; test specs created for synthetic

process_inventory.name: Software Qualification Test
process_inventory.rationale: SW verification against requirements. foxBMS has unit tests (Unity/CMock); synthetic_reference needs qualification test traceability.
process_inventory.disposition: partially_mapped - unit tests inventoried; qualification traceability created for synthetic

process_inventory.name: Software Configuration Management
process_inventory.rationale: Configuration management of SW artifacts. foxBMS uses Git/Waf; synthetic_reference needs CM records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - Git history as CM evidence; synthetic baselines defined

process_inventory.name: Hardware Requirements Analysis
process_inventory.rationale: HW requirements from system requirements. foxBMS has hardware design packages; synthetic_reference needs explicit HW requirements.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - HW requirements derived from design packages; synthetic created

process_inventory.name: Hardware Architectural Design
process_inventory.rationale: HW architecture with blocks, interfaces. foxBMS has schematics/BOM; synthetic_reference needs HW architecture.
process_inventory.disposition: partially_mapped - design packages inventoried; architecture extracted where readable

process_inventory.name: Hardware Detailed Design
process_inventory.rationale: Detailed HW design (schematics, layout, BOM). foxBMS has Altium packages; synthetic_reference references these.
process_inventory.disposition: partially_mapped - design packages referenced; detailed analysis limited by CAD format

process_inventory.name: Hardware Integration and Test
process_inventory.rationale: HW integration and verification. foxBMS has bring-up implied; synthetic_reference needs HW integration test specs.
process_inventory.disposition: gap - synthetic test specs created; as_is lacks explicit HW test records

process_inventory.name: Validation
process_inventory.rationale: Validation against stakeholder needs/use cases. Synthetic reference needs validation plan; as_is has no validation records.
process_inventory.disposition: gap - synthetic validation plan created; as_is has no validation evidence

process_inventory.name: Supplier Monitoring
process_inventory.rationale: Monitoring of suppliers (AFEs, SBC, MCU, sensors). foxBMS uses multiple vendors; synthetic_reference needs supplier monitoring records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - supplier inventory created; synthetic monitoring records

process_inventory.name: Release Management
process_inventory.rationale: Release of SW/HW. foxBMS has versioned releases (v1.11.0); synthetic_reference needs release management process.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - release process documented; synthetic release artifacts

process_inventory.name: Quality Assurance
process_inventory.rationale: QA processes for development. foxBMS has code reviews, static analysis config; synthetic_reference needs QA records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - QA approach documented; synthetic review records

process_inventory.name: Configuration Management
process_inventory.rationale: CM for all work products. foxBMS uses Git; synthetic_reference needs CM for all artifacts.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - Git + Waf as CM; synthetic CM records

process_inventory.name: Problem Resolution Management
process_inventory.rationale: Defect/issue tracking. foxBMS uses GitHub issues; synthetic_reference needs problem resolution records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - GitHub issues as evidence; synthetic problem records

process_inventory.name: Change Request Management
process_inventory.rationale: Formal change control. foxBMS has PRs/commits; synthetic_reference needs change request process.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - PR/commit history as evidence; synthetic change lifecycle demos

process_inventory.name: Traceability Management
process_inventory.rationale: Bidirectional traceability. THIS CORPUS IS THE TRACEABILITY IMPLEMENTATION.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - corpus implements traceability; matrices generated

process_inventory.name: Project Management
process_inventory.rationale: Project planning/monitoring. Synthetic reference needs project plan; as_is has no project management records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic project plan created; as_is has no PM records

process_inventory.name: Risk Management
process_inventory.rationale: Project risk management. Synthetic reference needs risk register; as_is has no risk records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic risk register created

process_inventory.name: Measurement
process_inventory.rationale: Process/product measurement. Synthetic reference needs measurement definitions; as_is has no measurement records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic measurement plan created

process_inventory.name: Process Improvement
process_inventory.rationale: Process improvement. Synthetic reference needs improvement records; as_is has no process improvement records.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - synthetic improvement records created

process_inventory.name: Reuse Program Management
process_inventory.rationale: Reuse of components (FreeRTOS, drivers). foxBMS reuses FreeRTOS, vendor drivers; synthetic_reference needs reuse management.
process_inventory.disposition: mapped - reuse inventory created; assessments for vendor code
